name: tool-call
description: A component for displaying AI tool/function calls with status, arguments, and results
designIntent: The ToolCall component visualizes when an AI agent uses tools or functions. It shows the tool name, status (pending, running, completed, failed), arguments passed, and the result returned. This provides transparency into the AI's actions.

props.name: toolCall
props.description: The tool call object containing name, arguments, status, and result

props.name: showResult
props.description: Whether to display the tool result

examples.title: Completed tool call
examples.code:
<ToolCall 
  toolCall={{
    id: '1',
    name: 'search',
    arguments: { query: 'React components' },
    status: 'completed',
    result: { results: [...] }
  }}
/>
examples.description: Tool call that completed successfully with result

examples.title: Running tool call
examples.code:
<ToolCall 
  toolCall={{
    id: '2',
    name: 'calculate',
    arguments: { expression: '2 + 2' },
    status: 'running'
  }}
/>

examples.title: Failed tool call
examples.code:
<ToolCall 
  toolCall={{
    id: '3',
    name: 'api_request',
    arguments: { endpoint: '/users' },
    status: 'failed',
    result: { error: 'Timeout' }
  }}
/>
examples.description: Tool call that failed with error message

antiPatterns.title: Don't show tool calls for simple operations
antiPatterns.description: Tool calls should be shown for meaningful operations, not trivial ones.

antiPatterns.title: Don't expose sensitive data in arguments
antiPatterns.description: Never display sensitive credentials or personal data in tool call arguments.

antiPatterns.title: Don't ignore failed tool calls
antiPatterns.description: Failed tool calls should be clearly indicated with error information.

accessibility.implementation: Status is shown with both color and text label for clarity
accessibility.userRequirements: Ensure status colors have sufficient contrast in both light and dark modes

accessibility.implementation: Arguments and results are displayed in pre/code blocks with proper formatting
accessibility.userRequirements: Test JSON display with screen readers for complex nested structures

accessibility.implementation: Tool call information is organized in clear sections (header, arguments, result)
accessibility.userRequirements: Use semantic headings for screen reader navigation

guidelines: Names should indicate what the tool does
Prefix related tools with a common namespace
Use standard status terminology (pending, running, completed, failed)
Be consistent with status labels across the application
For failed states, include error information when available
Use color coding to reinforce status meaning

compositionRules.relationship: ToolCall components are typically displayed within assistant messages to show tool usage
compositionRules.example: Message component can contain ToolCall to show when the AI used tools during its response

compositionRules.relationship: Reasoning often precedes ToolCall to explain why a tool is being invoked
compositionRules.example: Reasoning explains the decision to use a tool, ToolCall shows the actual invocation
